name: Italian Pumpkin Risotto
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Heat the olive oil with half the butter in a wide pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the pumpkin and cook for 5 minutes until it starts to soften and brown lightly.
Stir in the rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the wine and let it evaporate.
Add the hot stock one ladle at a time, stirring often, for about 18 minutes until the rice is creamy and tender.
Off the heat, stir in the remaining butter and the Parmesan, season, and rest for 2 minutes before serving.

name: French Onion Soup
steps: Melt the butter with the oil in a heavy pot and add the onions with the sugar and a pinch of salt.
Cook over medium-low heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden brown.
Pour in the wine and scrape up the browned bits, then simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the stock and thyme, simmer for 20 minutes, then season.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top with toasted baguette and Gruyère, and grill until bubbling and golden.

name: American Pumpkin Pie
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Whisk the pumpkin puree, eggs, sugar, spices, and salt until smooth.
Stir in the evaporated milk and pour the filling into the crust.
Bake for 15 minutes, then lower the heat to 175°C (350°F) and bake 40 minutes more until the center is just set.
Cool completely on a rack before slicing.

name: Hungarian Goulash
steps: Brown the beef in the lard in a heavy pot, then remove and set aside.
Cook the onions in the same pot for 8 minutes until soft.
Off the heat, stir in the paprika, garlic, caraway, and tomato paste, then return the beef.
Add the stock, cover, and simmer gently for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and pepper and cook 25 minutes more until everything is tender, then season.

name: Japanese Mushroom Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and drain for 15 minutes.
Place the rice in a pot or rice cooker with the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sake.
Scatter the mushrooms and tofu on top without stirring.
Cook covered until done, about 15 minutes on the stove over low heat after boiling, then rest 10 minutes.
Fluff gently, fold in the mushrooms, and top with scallions.

name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Prunes
steps: Toss the chicken with the garlic, ginger, turmeric, saffron, salt, and pepper and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a tagine or heavy pot and brown the chicken on both sides.
Add the onions and 250 ml water, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes.
Add the prunes, honey, and cinnamon and cook uncovered for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Serve topped with toasted almonds.

name: Spanish Mushroom Croquettes
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion and mushrooms for 10 minutes until all moisture evaporates.
Stir in the flour for 2 minutes, then add the milk gradually, whisking until a thick paste forms.
Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper, spread on a tray, and chill for 3 hours.
Shape into small logs, dip in egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil at 180°C until golden, about 2 minutes, and drain on paper towels.

name: German Apple Strudel
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Mix the apples with sugar, cinnamon, raisins, and lemon juice.
Layer the dough sheets, brushing each with butter, and sprinkle breadcrumbs over the top sheet.
Spoon the apples along one edge, roll up tightly, and tuck in the ends.
Brush with butter, bake for 35 minutes until golden, and dust with powdered sugar.

name: Korean Kimchi Jjigae
steps: Heat the sesame oil in a pot and fry the pork for 3 minutes.
Add the kimchi and garlic and sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in the gochugaru and gochujang, then add the stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the flavors deepen.
Add the tofu and simmer 5 more minutes, then top with scallions.

name: British Shepherd's Pie
steps: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes, drain, and mash with the butter and milk.
Brown the lamb in a pan, then add the onion and carrots and cook 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour, tomato paste, Worcestershire, and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Spread the filling in a baking dish and top with the mash, marking with a fork.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Irish Colcannon
ingredients: 800 g floury potatoes, peeled and cubed
250 g kale or green cabbage, shredded
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 18 minutes until tender, then drain.
Steam or simmer the kale for 5 minutes until tender.
Mash the potatoes with the warm milk and half of the butter.
Fold in the kale and scallions and season well.
Serve hot with a well of the remaining butter in the center.

name: French Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 6 firm apples, peeled, cored, and halved
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Melt the butter and sugar in an oven-safe skillet until golden caramel, about 6 minutes.
Arrange the apples rounded side down, packed tightly, and cook for 10 minutes.
Cover with the pastry, tucking in the edges, and bake for 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
Rest for 5 minutes, then invert onto a plate carefully and serve warm.

name: Polish Pierogi with Potato and Cheese
steps: Mix the flour, egg, water, and salt into a soft dough and rest for 30 minutes.
Fry the onion in butter until golden and mix with the potatoes and cheese, then season.
Roll the dough thin, cut into rounds, and fill each with a spoonful of filling.
Fold and pinch the edges to seal.
Boil in salted water until they float, about 4 minutes, then serve with sour cream.

name: Chinese Pumpkin Congee
steps: Rinse the rice and add it to a pot with the water and ginger.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the pumpkin and cook for 25 minutes until the rice breaks down and the congee is thick.
Season with salt and soy sauce.
Serve drizzled with sesame oil and topped with scallions.

name: British Sausage and Mash
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes, drain, and mash with butter and milk.
Brown the sausages in a pan for 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through, then set aside.
Cook the onions in the same pan for 12 minutes until soft and browned.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and Worcestershire, and simmer for 8 minutes until thickened.
Serve the sausages over the mash with onion gravy.

name: Turkish Pumpkin Dessert
ingredients: 800 g pumpkin, peeled and cut in chunks
Tahini or clotted cream (kaymak) for serving
steps: Layer the pumpkin in a wide pot and sprinkle with the sugar.
Let it rest for 2 hours so the pumpkin releases its juices.
Add the water and cloves, cover, and cook over low heat for 35 minutes until tender and glossy.
Cool in the syrup.
Serve topped with walnuts and a spoonful of tahini or kaymak.

name: Japanese Kabocha Squash Soup
ingredients: 500 g kabocha squash, peeled and cubed
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the squash and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until very tender.
Blend until smooth.
Return to the pot, stir in the milk and miso, and warm gently without boiling.
Season and serve hot.

name: Spanish Chickpea and Spinach Stew
steps: Fry the bread and garlic in the oil until golden and crush them into a paste.
Stir in the paprika and cumin, then add the vinegar and water.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

name: American Apple Crisp
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice and place in a baking dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar, and butter together until crumbly.
Cover the apples with the topping.
Bake for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Georgian Khachapuri
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, milk, and oil into a dough, knead 8 minutes, and rise for 1 hour.
Combine the cheeses.
Divide the dough in two, shape into boat shapes, and fill with the cheese, pinching the ends.
Bake at 230°C (450°F) for 12 minutes.
Crack an egg into each center, bake 3 minutes more, and top with butter.

name: Korean Japchae
steps: Boil the noodles for 6 minutes, drain, and toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp sesame oil.
Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds, squeeze dry, and season lightly.
Marinate the beef with garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and a little sugar.
Stir-fry the onion, carrot, mushrooms, and beef separately until cooked.
Toss everything with the remaining soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil, and top with sesame seeds.

name: Italian Mushroom Polenta
steps: Bring the water to a boil with salt and whisk in the polenta in a steady stream.
Cook on low for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Sauté the mushrooms in the oil over high heat for 8 minutes until browned, adding the garlic at the end.
Stir the butter and Parmesan into the polenta.
Top with mushrooms and parsley.

name: Moroccan Bissara
ingredients: 250 g dried split fava beans, soaked overnight
steps: Drain the soaked beans and place in a pot with the garlic and water.
Simmer for 45 minutes until very soft.
Blend until smooth and return to the pot over low heat.
Season with salt, cumin, and lemon juice and adjust consistency with hot water.
Serve in bowls drizzled with olive oil and paprika.

name: German Potato Pancakes (Kartoffelpuffer)
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion and squeeze out excess liquid in a clean towel.
Mix with the eggs, flour, and salt.
Heat 1 cm of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry spoonfuls, flattened, for 3 to 4 minutes per side until crisp and golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve with applesauce.

name: Dutch Stamppot with Kale
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 10 minutes.
Add the kale and sausage and cook 12 minutes more until tender.
Remove the sausage and drain the vegetables.
Mash with the butter, warm milk, and mustard, then season.
Slice the sausage and serve over the stamppot.

name: Egyptian Koshari
steps: Boil the lentils for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Cook the rice with salt, and boil the macaroni separately.
Fry the onions in oil until deep golden and crisp.
Simmer the garlic, tomatoes, cumin, chili, and vinegar for 15 minutes into a sauce.
Layer rice, lentils, macaroni, and chickpeas, then top with sauce and crispy onions.

name: Algerian Chakhchoukha
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil with the onion for 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and spices, then add the water.
Simmer covered for 1 hour until the lamb is tender.
Add the chickpeas and cook 10 minutes.
Steam the shredded bread over the broth or moisten with sauce, then serve topped with lamb.

name: Syrian Kibbeh
steps: Soak the bulgur for 15 minutes and squeeze dry, then knead with 250 g lamb, the grated onion, half the allspice, and salt into a smooth paste.
Cook the remaining lamb with the diced onion, pine nuts, cinnamon, and butter for 10 minutes for the filling.
Shape the shell mixture into hollow ovals and fill with the stuffing.
Seal and shape into torpedo forms.
Fry in hot oil for 5 minutes until deep brown and crisp.

name: French Beef Bourguignon
steps: Brown the lardons and set aside, then brown the beef in the fat in batches.
Cook the onion and carrots for 5 minutes and add the garlic.
Sprinkle with flour, add the tomato paste, then the wine and stock, and return the beef and lardons with the thyme.
Cover and cook at 160°C (325°F) for 2 hours 30 minutes.
Sauté the mushrooms, stir them in, and cook 15 minutes more.

name: Italian Lasagna
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in olive oil, add the passata, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Layer meat sauce, lasagna sheets, and béchamel in a baking dish, repeating the layers.
Top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake covered for 25 minutes, then uncovered 15 minutes until golden, and rest 10 minutes.

name: Mexican Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Fry the tortilla strips in oil until crisp and set aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic until soft, then add the cumin, chipotle, tomatoes, and stock.
Add the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes until cooked, then shred it.
Return the shredded chicken and add the lime juice.
Serve topped with tortilla strips, avocado, and cilantro.

name: Japanese Chicken Ramen
steps: Simmer the stock with ginger, soy sauce, and mirin for 10 minutes.
Pan-sear the chicken thighs for 6 minutes per side, then slice.
Boil the noodles according to the package, drain well.
Divide the noodles between bowls and ladle over the hot broth.
Top with chicken, eggs, scallions, nori, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Indian Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, half the spices, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken until charred and cooked through.
Cook the onion in butter for 6 minutes, add the tomato puree and remaining spices, and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend the sauce smooth, then return to the pan with the cream and sugar.
Add the chicken and fenugreek and simmer for 8 minutes.

name: Greek Avgolemono Soup
steps: Bring the stock to a boil, add the orzo, and cook for 10 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice until frothy.
Slowly whisk 2 ladles of hot broth into the eggs to temper them.
Pour the egg mixture back into the pot off the heat, stirring constantly, and add the chicken.
Warm gently without boiling, season, and serve with dill.

name: Swiss Cheese Fondue
steps: Rub the inside of a fondue pot with the garlic.
Heat the wine and lemon juice until just simmering.
Toss the cheeses with the cornstarch and add gradually, stirring in a figure 8 until smooth.
Stir in the kirsch and nutmeg.
Serve warm with bread cubes on forks.

name: Brazilian Feijoada
ingredients: 400 g dried black beans, soaked overnight
steps: Drain the beans and simmer in fresh water with the bay leaves for 1 hour.
Brown the bacon, ribs, and sausage, then add the onion and garlic.
Add the meats to the beans and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes until everything is tender.
Mash a few beans to thicken and season.
Serve with rice and orange wedges.

name: Irish Beef Guinness Stew
steps: Toss the beef in flour and brown in oil in batches.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, add the tomato paste, then pour in the Guinness and stock.
Return the beef with the thyme and simmer covered for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook 30 minutes more.
Season to taste and serve hot.

name: Austrian Wiener Schnitzel
steps: Pound the cutlets until 5 mm thick and season with salt and pepper.
Set up three plates with flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs without pressing hard.
Fry in hot butter for 2 to 3 minutes per side, swirling the pan so the breading puffs.
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon.

name: Russian Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin, cut in strips
steps: Sear the beef strips quickly in hot butter and set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms until golden.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and mustard, and simmer 5 minutes until thickened.
Return the beef and warm through.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat, season, and serve over noodles.

name: French Raclette
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until tender.
Heat the raclette grill or oven broiler.
Melt the cheese slices in small pans until bubbling and lightly browned.
Pour over the potatoes.
Serve with ham, cornichons, pickled onions, and pepper.

name: Polish Bigos
steps: Brown the bacon, pork, and kielbasa in a large pot.
Add the onion and cook until soft.
Add both cabbages, the soaked mushrooms with their liquid, bay leaves, tomato paste, and stock.
Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Season, and for best flavor rest overnight and reheat.

name: Mexican Pozole Rojo
ingredients: Shredded cabbage, radishes, and lime for serving
steps: Simmer the pork with half the onion, 2 garlic cloves, and salt for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Soak the chilies in hot water for 15 minutes and blend with the remaining onion, garlic, and oregano into a sauce.
Strain the sauce into the pork pot and add the hominy.
Simmer 30 minutes until tender and rich.
Serve with cabbage, radishes, and lime.

name: Swiss Rösti
ingredients: 700 g waxy potatoes, boiled and cooled
steps: Grate the cooled potatoes coarsely and mix with the onion, salt, and pepper.
Heat the butter and oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Press the potato mixture in evenly into a cake.
Cook for 12 minutes until golden underneath.
Flip using a plate and cook another 10 minutes until crisp on both sides.

name: Japanese Oden
ingredients: 1 daikon radish, cut in thick rounds
steps: Simmer the daikon in water for 15 minutes to soften and drain.
Combine the dashi, soy sauce, and mirin in a large pot.
Add the daikon, potatoes, and konnyaku and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the eggs and fish cakes and simmer 15 minutes more.
Serve hot with karashi mustard.

name: Hungarian Chicken Paprikash
steps: Brown the chicken in the lard and set aside.
Cook the onions until soft, then remove from heat and stir in the paprika.
Add the pepper, tomato, stock, and chicken and simmer covered for 35 minutes.
Whisk the sour cream with the flour and temper it with a little hot sauce.
Stir into the pot and simmer gently for 5 minutes, then serve with dumplings or noodles.

name: Filipino Chicken Adobo
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce and garlic for 30 minutes.
Place the chicken and marinade in a pot with the vinegar, bay leaves, peppercorns, and water.
Bring to a boil without stirring, then simmer covered for 30 minutes.
Uncover and reduce the sauce for 10 minutes, adding the sugar.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Serbian Ćevapi
ingredients: Flatbread, chopped onion, and ajvar for serving
steps: Mix the beef, lamb, onion, garlic, baking soda, salt, and pepper well by hand.
Cover and chill for at least 4 hours.
Shape into small fingers about 7 cm long.
Grill or pan-fry for 4 minutes per side until browned.
Serve with flatbread, chopped onion, and ajvar.

name: Norwegian Fish Soup
steps: Melt the butter and soften the leek and carrots for 5 minutes.
Add the stock and potatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Pour in the cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the fish and cook for 5 minutes until just opaque.
Season, sprinkle with dill, and serve.

name: Chinese Hot Pot
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer in a pot with the ginger, scallions, and soy sauce at the table.
Arrange the beef, vegetables, tofu, mushrooms, and noodles on plates.
Cook the vegetables and tofu in the broth first for 5 minutes.
Dip the thin beef slices for 20 to 30 seconds until cooked.
Dip in sesame sauce and finish with noodles in the broth.

name: Spanish Fabada Asturiana
ingredients: 400 g dried white fabes or cannellini beans, soaked overnight
steps: Place the soaked beans, onion, garlic, and pork belly in a pot, covered with water.
Bring to a boil, skim, and simmer on low heat for 1 hour.
Add the chorizo, morcilla, paprika, and saffron.
Simmer gently another 45 minutes until the beans are creamy.
Season and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Italian Ribollita
steps: Sauté the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic in oil for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, kale, and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add the beans, mashing a third of them to thicken.
Stir in the torn bread and cook 10 minutes until thick.
Serve drizzled with olive oil.

name: Lebanese Shish Barak
steps: Knead the flour, water, and a pinch of salt into a smooth dough and rest for 30 minutes.
Cook the beef with the onion, pine nuts, and spices until browned.
Roll the dough thin, cut circles, fill with beef, and pinch into small dumplings, then bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden.
Heat the yogurt with the egg white and cornstarch, stirring in one direction until it thickens, and add garlic.
Simmer the dumplings in the yogurt sauce for 10 minutes and top with mint.

name: Jamaican Oxtail Stew
steps: Season the oxtail with soy sauce, garlic, allspice, thyme, and salt and rest for 1 hour.
Caramelize the brown sugar in oil, then brown the oxtail on all sides.
Add the onion, Scotch bonnet, and water and simmer covered for 2 hours 30 minutes.
Add the carrots and cook 20 minutes.
Stir in the butter beans and simmer 10 minutes until the sauce is thick.

name: Egyptian Molokhia
ingredients: 400 g fresh or frozen molokhia leaves, finely chopped
1 whole chicken leg and thigh set
steps: Simmer the chicken in water or stock for 35 minutes until cooked and set aside.
Bring the stock to a simmer and add the molokhia, cooking 10 minutes without boiling hard.
Fry the garlic with the coriander in ghee until golden and fragrant.
Stir the garlic mixture into the molokhia with a hiss and cook 2 minutes.
Serve over rice with the chicken.

name: Saudi Chicken Kabsa
ingredients: 50 g raisins and toasted almonds for garnish
steps: Brown the chicken in oil and set aside.
Cook the onions until golden, add the garlic, spices, tomatoes, and tomato paste, and cook 8 minutes.
Add the chicken and water and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken, add the soaked rice to the broth, and cook covered for 20 minutes.
Serve topped with the chicken, raisins, and almonds.

name: Saudi Jareesh
steps: Soak the crushed wheat for 2 hours and drain.
Simmer the wheat in the stock for 45 minutes, stirring often.
Mash and stir with a wooden spoon until thick and porridge-like.
Stir in the yogurt, cumin, cardamom, and salt and cook 10 minutes.
Serve with ghee poured over and fried onions.

name: Saudi Saleeg
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock for 20 minutes, remove, and shred.
Rinse the rice and cook it in the stock until nearly tender, about 15 minutes.
Add the milk gradually and cook on low heat, stirring, until creamy.
Season with salt, cardamom, and saffron.
Top with the shredded chicken and ghee.

name: Moroccan Couscous with Seven Vegetables
steps: Brown the meat with the onion, turmeric, and ginger in the oil.
Add the water and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the carrots, turnips, and cabbage and cook 20 minutes, then add the zucchini, pumpkin, and chickpeas for 15 minutes.
Steam the couscous with a little water and butter, fluffing with a fork.
Serve the couscous topped with meat and vegetables and ladle the broth over it.

name: Algerian Rechta
ingredients: 300 g rechta noodles or thin fresh pasta
steps: Brown the chicken with the onion and spices in the oil.
Add the water, turnips, carrots, and chickpeas and simmer for 35 minutes.
Steam the noodles for 15 minutes over the simmering broth.
Toss with a little butter or oil.
Serve covered with the chicken, vegetables, and sauce.

name: Palestinian Maqluba
steps: Fry the eggplant and cauliflower until golden and drain.
Simmer the chicken with the onion and spices for 20 minutes and reserve the stock.
Layer tomatoes, chicken, eggplant, and cauliflower in a pot, then add the rice on top.
Pour in the hot stock, cover, and cook for 30 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes, invert onto a platter, and sprinkle with almonds.

name: Syrian Shish Barak
steps: Knead the flour, water, and salt into a dough and rest for 30 minutes.
Cook the lamb with the onion, pine nuts, and spices until browned.
Roll out the dough, cut rounds, fill, and pinch into small dumplings, then bake until golden.
Heat the yogurt with the cornstarch, stirring in one direction until simmering, and add the garlic.
Simmer the dumplings in the yogurt and finish with mint fried in butter.

name: Italian Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente and reserve 100 ml of the cooking water.
Sauté the carrot and asparagus in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add the zucchini, peas, garlic, and tomatoes and cook 4 minutes more.
Toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with Parmesan, basil, salt, and pepper.

name: Greek Spanakopita
ingredients: 80 g melted butter or olive oil
steps: Wilt the spinach with the onion and scallions, then squeeze dry.
Mix with the feta, eggs, dill, and pepper.
Layer half the filo in a baking dish, brushing each sheet with butter.
Spread the filling and top with the remaining filo, brushing each sheet.
Score the top and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 40 minutes until golden.

name: Japanese Chicken Teriyaki
steps: Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar for the sauce.
Sear the chicken skin-side down in oil for 6 minutes until crisp, then flip and cook 4 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer, spooning it over the chicken, until thick and glossy, about 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken and spoon over extra sauce.
Serve with rice and sesame seeds.

name: Lebanese Tabbouleh
steps: Soak the bulgur in cold water for 15 minutes and drain, squeezing out excess water.
Chop the parsley very finely and the mint, and dice the tomatoes.
Combine the herbs, tomatoes, scallions, and bulgur.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
Chill for 20 minutes before serving.

name: Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls
steps: Prepare all the fillings and cook the vermicelli.
Dip one wrapper in warm water for 10 seconds until pliable.
Layer lettuce, noodles, vegetables, mint, and shrimp on the wrapper.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Whisk the hoisin, peanut butter, and lime juice with a little water for the dipping sauce.

name: Spanish Tortilla Española
steps: Fry the potatoes and onion gently in the oil for 20 minutes until tender but not browned, then drain.
Beat the eggs with salt and fold in the warm potatoes and onion.
Let the mixture rest for 10 minutes.
Cook in a hot non-stick pan on medium-low for 5 minutes until the base is set.
Flip using a plate, cook 3 minutes more, and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Turkish Menemen
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion and peppers for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until saucy.
Season with salt and Aleppo pepper.
Crack in the eggs and stir gently.
Cook until just set but still soft and serve with bread.

name: French Quiche Lorraine
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and blind-bake the shell for 10 minutes.
Fry the lardons until crisp and scatter over the shell with the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, cream, milk, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Pour the custard into the shell.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden, and cool 10 minutes.

name: Indian Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes and blend into a puree.
Fry the cumin seeds, onion, garlic, and ginger in oil until golden.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes, then add the garam masala and spinach puree.
Simmer for 8 minutes and stir in the paneer and cream.
Cook 3 minutes and season to taste.

name: American Strawberry Shortcake
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt, and rub in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the milk to make a soft dough and drop in 4 mounds on a tray.
Bake for 14 minutes until golden.
Macerate the strawberries with the sugar, split the biscuits, and fill with strawberries and cream.

name: British Chicken and Leek Pie
steps: Sauté the chicken in butter for 5 minutes, add the leeks, and cook 5 minutes more.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream, and mustard and simmer for 10 minutes to thicken.
Season and cool, then pour into a pie dish.
Cover with the pastry, trim, and brush with egg.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Turkish Sigara Böreği
ingredients: 6 sheets yufka or filo, cut into triangles
1 tsp flour mixed with water for sealing
steps: Mix the feta, parsley, and egg for the filling.
Place a spoonful at the wide end of each triangle.
Fold in the sides and roll into a thin cigar, sealing with the flour paste.
Fry in medium-hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain and serve warm.

name: Vietnamese Bánh Xèo
ingredients: Fresh herbs, lettuce, and nuoc cham for serving
steps: Whisk the rice flour, turmeric, coconut milk, water, scallions, and a pinch of salt into a thin batter.
Heat oil in a skillet and fry the pork and shrimp for 3 minutes.
Pour in a ladle of batter to coat the pan thinly.
Add bean sprouts, cover, and cook 3 minutes, then uncover until crisp.
Fold and serve with herbs, lettuce, and nuoc cham.

name: Greek Keftedes
steps: Mix the meat, onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, mint, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Roll into small balls and dust lightly with flour.
Fry in oil for 8 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve with tzatziki and lemon.

name: Indian Vegetable Pulao
steps: Rinse the rice and soak for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat the ghee and fry the whole spices and cumin for 30 seconds.
Cook the onion until golden, add the vegetables, and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, water, and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, rest 5 minutes, and fluff.

name: Japanese Okonomiyaki
steps: Mix the flour, dashi, and eggs into a batter and fold in the cabbage and scallions.
Heat oil in a skillet and pour in half the batter into a thick pancake.
Lay the bacon on top and cook 5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Repeat with the remaining batter.
Brush with sauce, drizzle with mayonnaise, and top with bonito flakes.

name: Spanish Patatas Bravas
steps: Toss the potatoes in oil and salt and roast at 220°C (425°F) for 35 minutes until crisp.
Heat a little oil and fry the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the paprika, cayenne, tomato sauce, and vinegar and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season the sauce with salt.
Spoon over the potatoes and add aioli.

name: Indonesian Gado-Gado
steps: Blanch the green beans, bean sprouts, and cabbage for 2 minutes each and drain.
Mash the garlic with the peanut butter, palm sugar, soy sauce, and lime juice.
Thin the sauce with warm water until pourable.
Arrange the vegetables, potatoes, tofu, eggs, and cucumber on a platter.
Pour the peanut sauce over and serve.

name: French Asparagus Quiche
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and blind-bake the shell for 10 minutes.
Blanch the asparagus for 2 minutes and sauté with the shallot in butter for 3 minutes.
Spread over the shell with the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, cream, milk, salt, and pepper and pour in.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden.

name: Ethiopian Misir Wot
steps: Cook the onions in a dry pot for 5 minutes, then add the oil and cook until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, berbere, and tomato paste and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils and water.
Simmer 25 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Season and serve with injera.

name: Korean Bibimbap
steps: Marinate the beef in soy sauce and a little sesame oil and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Sauté the carrot and zucchini separately, and blanch the spinach and sprouts and season with sesame oil.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Divide the rice into bowls and arrange the toppings.
Top with the egg, gochujang, and sesame seeds and mix before eating.

name: Italian Arancini
ingredients: 300 g Arborio rice, cooked and cooled
steps: Mix the cooled risotto rice with 1 egg and the Parmesan.
Scoop a portion, press a mozzarella cube and a few peas in the center, and shape into a ball.
Roll in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in oil at 170°C for 5 minutes until deep golden.
Drain and serve hot.

name: Mexican Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 200 g Oaxaca or Monterey Jack cheese, sliced
steps: Roast the poblanos until blistered, steam 10 minutes, peel, and make a slit to remove the seeds.
Stuff each with cheese.
Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold in the yolks.
Dredge the peppers in flour, dip in the egg batter, and fry until golden on both sides.
Simmer the tomatoes with onion and garlic for 10 minutes and serve over the peppers.

name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in a little coconut cream for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the eggplant and beans and cook 5 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and sugar and stir in basil.

name: Dutch Asparagus with Ham and Egg
steps: Boil the asparagus in salted water with a pinch of sugar for 12 minutes until tender.
Drain and arrange on plates with the ham and potatoes.
Melt the butter and mix with the chopped egg.
Season with nutmeg.
Spoon the butter and egg sauce over the asparagus.

name: Tunisian Brik
steps: Mix the tuna with the capers, parsley, and harissa.
Place a spoonful in the center of each sheet and make a well.
Crack an egg into the well.
Fold into a triangle and seal quickly.
Fry in hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes per side until crisp, keeping the yolk runny, and serve with lemon.

name: Algerian Makroud
steps: Rub the semolina with the butter and salt, then add orange blossom water to form a firm dough and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the dates with the cinnamon and roll into logs.
Roll the dough into a log, make a groove, fill with dates, and seal.
Cut into diamonds and fry until golden, about 5 minutes.
Soak in warm honey for 2 minutes and drain.

name: Palestinian Musakhan
steps: Season the chicken with sumac, allspice, and salt and roast at 200°C for 40 minutes.
Cook the onions in olive oil for 25 minutes until soft and sweet, adding sumac.
Spread the onions on the flatbreads.
Top with the chicken and bake for 5 minutes.
Garnish with pine nuts.

name: Syrian Muhammara
steps: Combine the peppers, walnuts, breadcrumbs, garlic, and spices in a food processor.
Blend until coarse.
Add the pomegranate molasses and the olive oil.
Blend until just smooth but still textured.
Season and serve with warm bread.

name: Syrian Fatteh
steps: Warm the chickpeas with a little water and cumin.
Mix the yogurt, garlic, tahini, and salt.
Layer the pita pieces in a dish and top with chickpeas and a little of the cooking liquid.
Spoon over the yogurt sauce.
Fry the pine nuts in butter until golden and pour over.

name: Greek Horiatiki Salad
steps: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, onion, pepper, and olives in a bowl.
Season with salt.
Dress with the olive oil and vinegar.
Top with the block of feta.
Sprinkle with oregano and serve.

name: Italian Caprese Salad
ingredients: Sea salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella evenly.
Alternate them on a platter with basil leaves between.
Season with salt and pepper.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Finish with balsamic glaze and serve at room temperature.

name: Mexican Fish Tacos
steps: Season the fish with chili powder, cumin, salt, and lime juice.
Cook in oil for 3 minutes per side until flaky.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice for the sauce.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with fish, cabbage, avocado, and sauce and top with cilantro.

name: Thai Pad Thai
steps: Soak the noodles in warm water for 20 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry the shrimp in oil for 2 minutes and push aside.
Scramble the eggs, then add the noodles, tamarind, fish sauce, and sugar.
Toss for 3 minutes until the noodles are tender and coated.
Add the sprouts and scallions and serve with peanuts and lime.

name: Spanish Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop the tomatoes, cucumber, and pepper.
Blend with the garlic and soaked bread until very smooth.
Add the oil and vinegar while blending.
Season with salt and strain if you prefer a finer texture.
Chill for 2 hours and serve cold.

name: American Classic Cheeseburger
steps: Form the beef into 4 patties slightly larger than the buns and season both sides.
Cook in a hot skillet or grill for 3 minutes per side.
Add the cheese in the last minute and cover to melt.
Toast the buns in butter.
Assemble with the patty, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and sauces.

name: Japanese Chicken Yakitori
ingredients: 600 g chicken thighs, cut in cubes
steps: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar for 10 minutes until slightly thick for the tare.
Thread the chicken and scallions alternately on skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side.
Brush with tare and grill for 2 minutes per side, repeating until glazed.
Serve hot.

name: Lebanese Chicken Shawarma
ingredients: Garlic sauce, pickles, and tomatoes for serving
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, lemon, garlic, spices, and oil for at least 3 hours.
Roast at 220°C (425°F) for 25 minutes or grill until charred.
Rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Warm the flatbreads.
Fill with chicken, garlic sauce, pickles, and tomatoes and roll up.

name: Italian Pesto Pasta
steps: Blend the basil, pine nuts, garlic, and Parmesan with the oil into a sauce.
Season with salt.
Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente and reserve a cup of the cooking water.
Toss the pasta with the pesto off the heat.
Loosen with pasta water as needed and serve.

name: Brazilian Açaí Bowl
steps: Blend the açaí, frozen banana, milk, and honey until thick and smooth.
Pour the mixture into a bowl.
Arrange the granola, sliced banana, and strawberries on top.
Sprinkle with coconut.
Serve immediately.

name: Greek Souvlaki
steps: Marinate the meat in oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper for 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill for 10 minutes, turning, until cooked and charred.
Warm the pitas.
Fill with meat, tzatziki, tomato, and onion.

name: Vietnamese Bún Chả
steps: Mix the ground pork with 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and garlic, shape into patties, and marinate the pork belly the same way for 30 minutes.
Grill both until charred and cooked through.
Whisk the remaining fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, and water for the dipping broth and add the carrot.
Place the grilled pork in the broth.
Serve with noodles, herbs, and lettuce.

name: Italian Panzanella Salad
steps: Toast the bread cubes with a little oil until crisp.
Toss the tomatoes with salt and let them release juices for 10 minutes.
Add the cucumber, onion, and basil.
Whisk the oil and vinegar and dress the salad.
Add the bread and rest for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Brazilian Moqueca
ingredients: 2 tbsp dendê (palm) oil or olive oil
steps: Marinate the fish in lime juice, garlic, and salt for 20 minutes.
Layer the onion, pepper, and tomatoes in a wide pot.
Add the fish on top and pour in the coconut milk and palm oil.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes without stirring.
Sprinkle with cilantro and serve with rice.

name: Turkish Çoban Salatası
steps: Dice the tomatoes, cucumbers, pepper, and onion evenly.
Mix in the parsley.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and sumac.
Toss and serve chilled.

name: Japanese Cold Soba Noodles
steps: Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, and mirin for 2 minutes and chill to make the dipping sauce.
Boil the soba for 4 to 5 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold running water.
Place the noodles on a plate and top with nori.
Serve with the sauce, scallions, wasabi, and daikon.

name: Moroccan Zaalouk
steps: Steam or boil the eggplant for 15 minutes until soft and drain.
Cook the tomatoes with the garlic and spices in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the eggplant and mash roughly.
Cook for 15 minutes until thick, stirring.
Finish with lemon and cilantro and serve warm or cold with bread.

name: Spanish Pinchos Morunos
steps: Mix the oil, garlic, spices, oregano, and lemon juice.
Marinate the pork for at least 4 hours.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Serve hot with lemon and bread.

name: American Corn Chowder
steps: Cut the corn from the cobs.
Fry the bacon until crisp and remove, then cook the onion in the fat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock, potatoes, and corn and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the milk and cream and warm 5 minutes.
Blend a third of the soup for thickness, season, and top with bacon.

name: Indonesian Nasi Goreng
ingredients: Cucumber and fried shallots for serving
steps: Fry the shallots and garlic in oil for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook for 4 minutes.
Push aside, scramble 1 egg, add the rice, and stir-fry on high heat.
Add the kecap manis, soy sauce, and sambal and toss for 3 minutes.
Top with a fried egg, cucumber, and fried shallots.

name: French Niçoise Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, and mustard for the dressing.
Boil the potatoes and blanch the green beans, then cool.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, and halved eggs on a platter.
Top with tuna, olives, and anchovies.
Drizzle with the dressing.

name: Peruvian Ceviche
ingredients: 500 g very fresh white fish, cubed
1 corn on the cob, cooked and sliced
steps: Salt the fish and toss with the chili.
Pour over the lime juice and let it cure for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add the onion and cilantro.
Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Serve immediately with the sweet potato and corn.

name: Lebanese Fattoush
steps: Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, sumac, and salt for the dressing.
Combine the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, radishes, and scallions.
Add the dried mint.
Toss with the dressing.
Add the toasted pita just before serving to keep it crisp.

name: Australian Pavlova
ingredients: Passion fruit and strawberries for topping
steps: Preheat the oven to 120°C (250°F) and line a tray.
Beat the egg whites to soft peaks, adding the sugar gradually until stiff and glossy.
Fold in the vinegar, cornstarch, and vanilla.
Shape into a round and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, then cool in the turned-off oven.
Top with cream and fruit.

name: Filipino Halo-Halo
steps: Divide the beans, banana, nata de coco, and jackfruit among two tall glasses.
Fill with shaved ice.
Pour the evaporated milk over the ice.
Top with ube ice cream and leche flan.
Sprinkle with pinipig and mix before eating.

name: Egyptian Ful Medames
steps: Warm the beans with a little of their liquid for 8 minutes.
Lightly mash some beans for thickness.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with olive oil, tomato, parsley, and eggs and serve with bread.

name: Egyptian Hawawshi
steps: Mix the beef with the onion, pepper, tomatoes, parsley, and spices.
Open the pitas and stuff with the mixture, spreading evenly.
Brush the outside with oil.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until the meat is cooked.
Slice and serve hot.

name: Tunisian Ojja
steps: Fry the sausages in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the peppers and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, harissa, and caraway and simmer 15 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes until the eggs set.

name: Palestinian Knafeh Nabulsiyeh
ingredients: 400 g Nabulsi or mozzarella cheese, soaked and shredded
steps: Simmer the sugar, water, and lemon juice for 10 minutes and add the orange blossom water for the syrup.
Toss the kataifi with the melted butter.
Press half in a pan, cover with the cheese, and top with the rest.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 30 minutes until golden.
Pour the syrup over and sprinkle with pistachios.
